verdict.rationale: Firebase offers managed NoSQL databases (Cloud Firestore, Realtime Database) with official client SDKs for web/mobile and Admin SDK for server-side access, backed by docs on data sync, offline caching, and security rules, plus CLI/GitHub tooling for data interaction; community hands-on reports confirm fast, real-time read/write from clients and servers. Missing for 10: independent benchmark on server SDK write/read latency, and community notes cite real limitations (query features, count queries, historical offline-persistence gaps) that keep it from a perfect score.
